name: ResonantImpact / death

request.text: 4-second dry close game SFX. Immediate loud attack. A dense hard impact followed by two clearly separated metallic rings, each lower in pitch, and a sustained low resonant pressure tail with a few hard settling rebounds. Audible evolving tail for 3 seconds; fade only at end. No voice, scream, music, ambience or reverb.
